scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 Monitor 操作场景：创建警报规则 → 列出警报 → 查询指标 → 删除规则
commands: az monitor alert create --name test-alert --resource-group test-rg --condition count > 0 --target test-vm
az monitor alert show --name test-alert --resource-group test-rg
az monitor alert delete --name test-alert --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：警报规则创建成功但指标查询失败
commands: az monitor alert create --name fail-alert --resource-group test-rg --condition count > 0 --target test-vm

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：警报规则不存在
commands: az monitor alert show --name nonexistent-alert --resource-group test-rg
